## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (lint, format, types, unit tests with coverage, build)
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes, or the change doesn't touch the UI
- [ ] New UI text is in `src/i18n.ts`, in both Spanish and English
- [ ] Keyboard and screen-reader use still work (see CONTRIBUTING → Accessibility)
- [ ] No API keys, prompts or conversations are logged or stored server-side
